purpose: zachytit toxicke alebo launch-ready situacie cez liquidity/stress proxy
mechanism_value: zlepsi veto mechanizmy a odlisi zdravy buildup od chaosu
mechanical_hypothesis: Toxic setups cluster when liquidity thins or bursts abnormally while stress persists, producing vacuum-like price behavior that should be vetoed before it is mistaken for healthy buildup.
harmful_subset_definition: harmful_subset means setups where abnormal volume, thin liquidity proxies, unstable wick pressure, and persistent stress jointly imply elevated risk of chaotic continuation or failed launch quality
